slug: 2025-12-02 Chad Accelerates Digital Cooperation to Support Its Transformation Agenda

facts.fact: Chad took part on 25-26 November 2025 in the drafting meeting of the founding texts of the planned Central African Digital Development Entities Conference (CADNAC), a regional platform for inter-state digital policy cooperation, per ADETIC as reported by Ecofin.
Ecofin reports that since January 2025 Chad has widened its collaboration with CEMAC member states on free roaming; the article gives no agreement or date beyond the year.
